must_keep.quote: Staff going on mission are automatically authorised to travel by air if the outward and return journeys by rail would to tal at least 800 kilometres. Air travel is permitted for shorter distances when justified on grounds of cost-efficiency.
must_keep.why: air automatically authorised at 800 km of rail out and back; shorter if cost-efficient

must_keep.quote: The cost of rail travel is reimbursed on the basis of the first class rail fare for the shortest route (either by distance or in terms of time) between the place of employment and the place of the mission. The
must_keep.why: rail is reimbursed at the first class fare

must_keep.quote: As a general rule, air travel may be booked: 1) in economy class or equivalent, including cases where the ticket in question cannot be exchanged or refunded, at the lowest available rates, taking into account the times of meetings and/or special features of the mission,
must_keep.why: economy, non-refundable included, at the lowest available rates and meeting times
